entities.name: UniProt:P95722 Obg
observations: Exact 478-aa query-sequence match to reviewed Streptomyces coelicolor Obg GTPase (UniProt P95722).
Essential Obg-family GTPase implicated in cell-cycle control, stress response, ribosome biogenesis, and differentiation/morphogenesis.
Binds GTP and GDP; may bind (p)ppGpp; annotated localization is cytoplasm and peripheral cell membrane.
In S. coelicolor, overexpression suppresses sporulation and decreases actinorhodin production; causal mechanism is not established here.
